arms.base: same pinned instruction-tuned checkpoint, no study-specific adaptation
arms.control: same admitted code pairs, role-only A labels; no benchmark-derived targets
arms.benchmark: same admitted code pairs, context-dependent C calibration labels

primary_endpoint: contract-macro proportion of fully usable generated records among ALL planned slots
reference: two independent fresh benchmark launches per implementation and profile; same decisive 5% ratio label in both
inference: descriptive pilot; no claim of statistical confirmation from one training seed
